title: Act 1 - Segment 1: Pallet Town to Pewter City (Boulder Badge)
synopsis: Begin your journey in Pallet Town, select your starter Pokemon from Professor Oak, deliver Oak's Parcel in Viridian City, navigate the treacherous bug-dense Viridian Forest, and defeat Gym Leader Brock in a 2v2 duel under the strict Level 14 Hard Mode level cap.
